title: Nipah virus border measures and SG Arrival Card declarations
asked: Ms Joan Pereira asked whether the Ministry would require health declarations and screen passengers arriving from high-risk Nipah virus areas at ports of entry, and provide healthcare advisories to doctors and the public.
response: Dr Koh Poh Koon said the Communicable Diseases Agency issued a press release on 28 January 2026 about Nipah virus infections in West Bengal, India. Since then, clinical guidance was issued to all medical practitioners, an educational webinar was held for primary care doctors, the electronic Health Declaration Card was adjusted for all incoming travellers, and temperature screening was activated for travellers arriving on ships from affected areas. The Ministry of Manpower disseminated CDA announcements to migrant workers, employers, dormitory operators and employment agencies. In reply to a supplementary question, he said the SG Arrival Card now prompts travellers who report symptoms to enter their previous travel destination, including West Bengal, and that information collected is piped to CDA for contact tracing.

key_points.point: CDA issued a press release on 28 January 2026 about Nipah virus infections in West Bengal, India.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: the Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) issued a press release on our responses to the Nipah virus infections in West Bengal, India, on 28 January 2026.

key_points.point: Clinical guidance was issued to all medical practitioners and an educational webinar was held for primary care doctors.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we have further issued clinical guidance to all medical practitioners, conducted an educational webinar for primary care doctors

key_points.point: The electronic Health Declaration Card was adjusted for all incoming travellers and temperature screening was activated for travellers arriving on ships from affected areas.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: adjusted the electronic Health Declaration Card for all incoming travellers and activated temperature screening for travellers arriving on ships from affected areas.

key_points.point: The Ministry of Manpower disseminated CDA announcements to migrant workers, migrant domestic workers, employers, dormitory operators and employment agencies.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: The Ministry of Manpower has also disseminated CDA’s announcements on precautionary health measures to migrant workers and migrant domestic workers as well as to employers, dormitory operators and employment agencies.

key_points.point: CDA is monitoring the situation in India and globally and will adjust measures based on evolving risks.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: CDA is monitoring the situation in India and globally closely, and will adjust our measures as needed based on the evolving risks that are developing.

key_points.point: The SG Arrival Card was enhanced; if a traveller clicks yes to any symptoms, they are prompted to enter their previous travel destination, including West Bengal.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: if the arriving individual, clicks yes on the SG Arrival Card to any of the symptoms, then there will be a prompt to enter the previous travel destination, and that would include the West Bengal region as well.

key_points.point: If a traveller clicks no to any symptoms, they are not prompted for monitored travel destinations.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: But if the person clicks no to any of the symptoms, then he would not be prompted for any travel destinations that we are monitoring.

key_points.point: Information collected by the SG Arrival declaration card is piped into CDA for contact tracing if necessary.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: Any of the information collected by the SG Arrival declaration card will indeed be piped into CDA so that we can perform any contact tracing if necessary.

left_open: Screening measures for air passengers arriving from high-risk areas
Advisories for the general public beyond migrant workers and employers
supplementary: Supplementary questions focused on SG Arrival Card travel-destination declarations and sharing that information with health authorities.
